name: Déjà vu
body:
Every so often, the god of fate sends you dreams about places and situations you will visit or experience in the future.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is the god of fate

Benefit: Once per day you may add a +5 divine bonus to any one skill check, ability check or saving throw. You may wait to decide to use the bonus until after you have rolled the dice, but must announce your intent to use the bonus before the GM announces whether or not the roll was successful.

Alternately, instead of using the bonus yourself you may grant the bonus to one (and only one) of your companions. Your companion must be within hearing or vision range of you in order to receive the bonus.
